authorGroups.name: Torbern Bergman
authorGroups.reason: The named scientific works and eighteenth-century context identify Torbern Bergman. The bibliography documents the Italian Opuscoli and its water-analysis essays. Torberno is an Italian name form; Toberno, Tobernts, Horbern and Bergiqaiän are catalogue/OCR variants. Unrelated Ernst and Peter Bergmann entries remain separate.

authorGroups.name: Jacques Cassini
authorGroups.reason: The early-eighteenth-century Cassini le fils is Jacques Cassini (Cassini II), distinct from his father Jean-Dominique. Full-name OCR variants are consolidated; individual catalogue misattributions are separately corrected.

authorGroups.name: Gian Domenico Cassini
authorGroups.reason: Rereading the source heading resolves Gian Domdnico to Gian Domenico; this is the father, Jean-Dominique Cassini, not Jacques.

w98e2aa1e56fc.reason: The catalogue's Cassini le fils is Jacques Cassini. Mayrargue explicitly attributes this 1700 memoir to Jacques. The cited edition has different pagination, so the physical offprint/edition remains unverified.

w265691be959e.displayTitle: Réflexions sur les observations faites en Botnie
w265691be959e.reason: The catalogue card explicitly says Jacques, but the scholarly bibliography attributes this work to Jean-Dominique Cassini. Preserve the typed heading and record the corrected work attribution separately; differing pagination does not verify the family's edition.
